endpoint: First downward crossing of 1 K in flux effective temperature; retain any later recrossings.
birth: Relaxed, deuterium-bearing extended initial model, age zero at initial contraction. Preserve isotope abundances, entropy and starting radius in each review.
stellar_physics: Use the campaign's documented EOS, opacity, composition transport and nuclear network in their assessed domains. Bind the specific configurations and physics transitions to each endpoint review.
atmosphere: Match to an atmosphere at a stated depth and within assessed temperature, gravity and composition coverage. Review overlap and the effect on elapsed cooling time across each change.
cold_reference: Isolated stable baryons; adopted screened mixed-fuel pycnonuclear source at nominal normalization, finite hydrogen budget and finite radioactive inventory. Record the source implementation, fuel redistribution, thermal reservoir and surface relation for each segment.
joins: Require continuity of age, structure, composition and energy at a native-to-reduced handover, with an elapsed-time comparison in the overlap.
adjudication: A domain violation or failed inventory check blocks adoption. A competing uncertain rate or fuel arrangement is reported as a sensitivity. A change to the reference prescription requires a new release or a documented applicability rule.
discovery: Retain ordered thermal reversals, luminosity and nuclear fraction, and document available fuel distribution, pressure support and duration before interpreting an abeyant burning phase.
